name: Wandile Nxumalo
intro: I build data products and the systems behind them: pipelines, AI agents and the tools people use every day.
about: I work across the stack at Nielsen Sports South Africa, taking projects from raw data to something a client or colleague can use.
I am driven by the endless possibility to know more, do more and be more in my craft, and I believe in growing young people with skills that can change their futures.

skills.title: Data engineering
skills.body: Ingestion from APIs and streams, warehouse modelling in SQL and BigQuery, and scheduled pipelines on Airflow.

skills.title: AI and machine learning
skills.body: Conversational agents over live data, computer vision, and supervised models from a CRISP-DM foundation.

skills.title: Full-stack development
skills.body: Web apps and internal tools in TypeScript, React and Python, containerised and deployed to the cloud.

skills.title: Data analysis
skills.body: Wrangling, exploring and visualising data with Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib to surface insights and trends.

experience.body: Building the data pipelines, AI products and internal tools behind sports-marketing research.
Worked in a small team on the academy's auto-mark project, an automation tool that marks recruits' code.
Learnt Java and was introduced to back-end programming.
Matriculated and found a passion for programming through Computer Applications Technology.
